description_expanded: Overview5.0(10 reviews)Gulf FrontGULF FRONT VIEWS-1st Floor-Renovated-Private Beach Access, FREE Beach Chairs - BMT 3BThe Space BMT 3B – Gulf-Front Bliss in Blue Mountain Beach! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Gulf-Front Condo – Breathtaking panoramic beach views from your private balcony Steps to the Sand – Direct access to Blue Mountain Beach’s sugar-white shores Open-Concept Living Area – Light-filled space with coastal-chic décor and plush seating Fully Equipped Kitchen – Modern appliances & a breakfast bar for easy dining Prime Location – Minutes from Seaside, Grayton Beach, and 30A’s best shopping & dining FREE Set of Beach Chairs - Memorial Day to Labor Day, one set with two chairs and one umbrella Welcome to BMT 3BThis cozy beach front townhome has everything to offer. Boasting beautiful gulf views, this one-bedroom beach front townhome is tucked away in scenic Blue Mountain Beach. With accommodations for four, this townhome offers the perfect spot for your next family vacation. You can take in the scenery of the Emerald Coast while you lounge on the townhome's private walkout patio followed by a relaxing day on this private beach. Once the family has had enough sun you can cool down with some of the best ice cream 30A has to offer just down the street at Blue Mountain Creamery. Six-foot wide sliding glass doors allow for unobstructed views of the white sandy beach from the open kitchen, dining and living areas. When you aren't spending the day at the beach, be sure to check out the variety of shopping and dining venues along 30A in the neighboring Seaside and WaterColor!House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**Multiple Families or guests? SEE UNIT 3A in the same complex located just above. 3A is a two-story, two-bedroom unit located just above this unit.** NO CABLE. STREAMING ONLY**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 4):Master Bedroom - Queen sized bedCommon area - Queen sized sleeper sofaAREA ATTRACTIONS:Welcome to Blue Mountain Beach, a hidden gem along Florida’s scenic Highway 30A! Known for its breathtaking white sand beaches, vibrant turquoise waters, and relaxed coastal charm, this community is the perfect destination for those seeking great food, sweet treats, shopping, and outdoor adventures.Start your day with a delicious breakfast at Blue Mountain Bakery, then swing by For the Health of It for quick grocery essentials and organic treats. When it’s time for lunch or dinner, savor fresh seafood and coastal flavors at Red Fish Taco, Shunk Gulley, or Cowgirl Kitchen, all just a short bike ride away. Enjoy some shopping at The Stalls on 30A, where you’ll find unique local treasures and coastal-inspired finds. And when it’s time for something sweet, indulge in homemade ice cream from Blue Mountain Beach Creamery, just a quick stroll from your doorstep.Whether you’re here to unwind on the beach, explore the area, or simply soak in the laid-back 30A lifestyle, you’ve found the perfect place to stay! Show less
